Proposed slate (5 loops, 60–75 mins each, panel debrief after last loop):
1) Hiring manager deep-dive — Sean Gallagher (inference architecture, oncall expectations)
2) Serving runtime tech — Mina Haddad (implementation/incident handling)
3) System design + scaling — Markus Klein (latency, batching)
4) Behavioral/ops scenarios — Vivek Kulkarni (oncall tradeoffs, escalations)
5) Final calibration — Marissa Cole (culture/role fit)

Candidate availability (Alex Rivera, PST): Nov 16–20, morning window 10:00–13:00 PT. Talento has prep notes and will coordinate times.

Logistics/asks:
- Please approve the slate and the accelerated 7–10 day timeline.
- We prefer back-to-back panels on Monday/Tuesday to minimize candidate context switching.
- Post-loop debrief: 30 mins same-day; hiring decision target within 48 hours of final loop.

Talento: Can you propose two concrete day schedules matching candidate availability?

Thanks,
